title: Cleanup of Target Enrichment PCR with QIAseq Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the eigth part of a ten part protocol for the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Kit](https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/instruments-and-automation/genereader-system/generead-qiaact-lung-panels-ww/?catno=181936) which constructs molecularly bar-coded DNA libraries for digital sequencing. This protocol automates the Cleanup of Target Enrichment PCR with QIAseq Beads part described in the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Handbook](https://www.qiagen.com/us/resources/download.aspx?id=1a71d98a-c45c-44fa-b4af-874cd1d2b61f&lang=en). * Part 1: [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210) * Part 2: [Reverse transcription](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-2) * Part 3: [Second strand synthesis](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-3) * Part 4: [End repair / dA tailing](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-4) * Part 5: [Adaptor ligation](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-5) * Part 6: [Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-6) * Part 7: [Target Enrichment PCR](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-7) * Part 8: [Cleanup of Target Enrichment PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-8) * Part 9: [Universal PCR Amplification](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-9) * Part 10: [Cleanup of Universal PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-10) Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: The total number of DNA samples. Samples must range between 1 (minimum) and 12 (maximum). * `P300 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. * `P20 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. * `Magnetic Module Engage Height (mm)`: The height the magnets should raise. ---
Engage magnet for 10 minutes to separate beads.
Completely remove residual supernatant from the samples.

steps.title: Centrifuge PCR products
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the forward and reverse PCR products as described.

steps.title: Combine forward and reverse PCR
steps.instruction: Combine each forward and reverse PCR product into the magnetic plate.

steps.title: Adjust volume to 100 µL
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL nuclease‑free water to each sample to bring the total volume to 100 µL.

steps.title: Add QIAact beads and mix
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL QIAact beads to each sample on the magnetic plate and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnet to bind beads
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 10 minutes to separate the beads.

steps.title: Remove supernatant completely
steps.instruction: Remove all liquid from the samples, ensuring no residual supernatant remains.

steps.title: Perform two 80% ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet twice with 80 % ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 % ethanol to the beads, then discard the ethanol

steps.title: Centrifuge, re‑magnetize, and remove residual
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples, place the plate back on the magnetic module, engage the magnet for 2 minutes, then remove any remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the bead pellet for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Add 16 µL nuclease‑free water to the beads and incubate to elute DNA.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to new PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer 13.4 µL of the eluate (supernatant) into fresh PCR tubes located in slot 2.
